summary: Sunbelt Rentals Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K with Items 8.01 and 9.01 to disclose the launch and pricing of a private offering of senior notes. On July 6-7, 2026, the company announced an intention to offer two series of benchmark-sized senior notes, subsequently pricing $450M of 4.950% Senior Notes due 2030 and $750M of 5.650% Senior Notes due 2036. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes including debt repayment, capex, and working capital. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
